title: Love in Hell
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rintaro Senkawa gets drunk one night, falls to his death and wakes in Hell, which runs like an ordinary city where the dead pay off their sins through punishment. His guide is the novice devil Koyori, whose promotion depends on his repentance (Seven Seas blurb via AniList/MU; Manga Bookshelf review of vol. 1).
life_message: Facing up to one's past wrongs is the way out, even when the process is absurd and painful.
